train_validation_test_split_version.note: Train/validation/test seed ranges are disjoint integer ranges in Phase 3A's own namespace (520000-522999), never overlapping Phase 1's default seed (0) or Phase 2A/2B's controlled-scenario namespace (410000-414999). Every scenario is built by the frozen Phase 1 generate_scenario function -- never a Phase-3A-local reimplementation -- so every guarantee generate_scenario already makes (>=1 usable provider when the pool is non-empty, etc.) applies identically to every split.
